0022600040.text: The Golden State Warriors (8-3, eight straight wins, 8-2 in their last ten) visit the San Antonio Spurs (10-2, 10-game win streak, 10-0 in their last ten) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, the Warriors' 13th of the season. Golden State is without Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while Stephen Curry is day-to-day with abdomen soreness and is a game-time decision. San Antonio is without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Warriors losing 127-113 in San Francisco on April 1, 2026.
